Which of the following is the primary basis for allocating seats in the Rajya Sabha among various States and Union Territories in India?

options.text: Population of each state or union territory

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Population of each state or union territory**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajya Sabha**, the upper house of the Indian Parliament, allocates seats to states and union territories based on their **population**.
 
• The allocation is done in accordance with the provisions of **Article 80 of the Indian Constitution**, which determines the seat distribution.
 
• States with higher populations are allocated more seats, ensuring proportional representation.
 
• The population data used for this purpose is derived from the **1971 Census**, as per the **42nd Amendment of the Constitution**.
 
• As of now, the Rajya Sabha consists of **245 members**, with most representatives elected by the legislative assemblies of states and union territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 80 of the Indian Constitution**:

 
 
• Specifies the composition of the Rajya Sabha, including representation from states, union territories, and nominated members.
 
• States are represented by members elected by their legislative assemblies using the **single transferable vote system**.
 
 
 
• **Allocation of Seats**:
 
 
• Each state is allocated seats in proportion to its population, ensuring equitable representation.
 
• Union territories such as Delhi and Puducherry are also represented, but with fewer seats.
 
 
 
• **42nd Constitutional Amendment**:
 
 
• Freezes the use of population data for seat allocation at the **1971 Census** level, to maintain uniformity.
 
 
 
• **Role of Rajya Sabha**:
 
 
• Acts as a federal chamber to represent the interests of states and union territories in the Parliament.
 
• Ensures that the voice of smaller states is not overshadowed in legislative processes.

questions.question: In February 2025, what was the protein isoform '1N4R tau' identified by the University of Cologne being explored for?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Treating Alzheimer's disease**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **1N4R tau** is an isoform of the tau protein, which is primarily associated with neurodegenerative disorders like Alzheimer's disease.
 
• This isoform is characterized by having **four microtubule-binding repeat regions** and one N-terminal insertion, making it relevant for studying tauopathies.
 
• Research by the University of Cologne in February 2025 explored the role of 1N4R tau in the **pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease**, particularly its involvement in tau aggregation.
 
• 1N4R tau accumulation in brain cells leads to the formation of toxic **neurofibrillary tangles**, which are a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease.
 
• The study aimed to investigate potential therapeutic approaches to **mitigate tau-induced neurotoxicity** and slow disease progression.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tau Proteins:**

 
 
• Tau proteins are microtubule-associated proteins that stabilize microtubules in neurons.
 
• When tau proteins become hyperphosphorylated, they detach from microtubules and aggregate, leading to cell damage.
 
 
 
• **Neurofibrillary Tangles:**
 
 
• Neurofibrillary tangles are clumps of tau protein found in the brains of individuals with Alzheimer's disease.
 
• They disrupt neural communication, contributing to cognitive decline.
 
 
 
• **Alzheimer's Disease:**
 
 
• Alzheimer's is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder characterized by memory loss, cognitive impairment, and behavioral changes.
 
• It is associated with the accumulation of beta-amyloid plaques and tau tangles in the brain.
 
 
 
• **Therapeutic Exploration:**
 
 
• Current research focuses on targeting tau aggregation as a potential therapeutic approach for Alzheimer's disease.
 
• Strategies include tau inhibitors, immunotherapy, and enhancing tau clearance mechanisms.

questions.question: T travelled 576 km, 630 km and 315 km at the speeds of 16 km/hr, 7 km/hr and 9 km/hr, respectively. Find his average speed in km/hr.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Average Speed** = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 576 + 630 + 315 = 1521 km

Total Time = (576/16) + (630/7) + (315/9) = 36 + 90 + 35 = 161 hours

Average Speed = 1521 ÷ 161 = 9 (72/161) km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9 (72/161) km/hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d921305b9845d6f4592d0fc2d698d61c08be604b26dcc2842078105ed4262f.png] 

**Given:**

Distances (d₁, d₂, d₃) = 576 km, 630 km, 315 km

Speeds (s₁, s₂, s₃) = 16 km/hr, 7 km/hr, 9 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

Average Speed = (d₁ + d₂ + d₃) ÷ (t₁ + t₂ + t₃)

**Calculations:**

⇒ t₁ = 576 ÷ 16 = 36 hours

⇒ t₂ = 630 ÷ 7 = 90 hours

⇒ t₃ = 315 ÷ 9 = 35 hours

⇒ Total Distance = 576 + 630 + 315 = 1521 km

⇒ Total Time = 36 + 90 + 35 = 161 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 1521 ÷ 161

⇒ Average Speed = 9 (72/161) km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 9 (72/161) km/hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, then Average Speed = 2xy/(x + y).

Relative Speed

In same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂. In opposite direction, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.</p

questions.question: Which Indian state shares its border with Bhutan and Bangladesh?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Assam** is the only Indian state that shares its borders with both **Bhutan** and **Bangladesh**.
 
• The state has an international border of approximately **267 km with Bhutan** and around **263 km with Bangladesh**.
 
• Located in the northeastern region of India, Assam plays a vital role in regional connectivity between India and its neighboring countries.
 
• Districts like **Udalguri, Baksa, and Chirang** share Assam's boundary with Bhutan, while districts like **Dhubri and Karimganj** touch the border with Bangladesh.
 
• Assam's strategic location facilitates trade and cultural exchange with Bhutan and Bangladesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Importance of Assam:**

 
 
• Assam is part of the **Seven Sister States** in northeastern India, bordered by Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, Meghalaya, and West Bengal.
 
• The state is known for its **Brahmaputra River**, which serves as a lifeline for agriculture and transportation.
 
 
 
• **Border with Bhutan:**
 
 
• Assam shares its northern boundary with Bhutan, a landlocked Himalayan kingdom.
 
• The Indo-Bhutan border is open, facilitating free movement of people and goods under the **Indo-Bhutan Friendship Treaty**.
 
 
 
• **Border with Bangladesh:**
 
 
• Assam’s border with Bangladesh is located to the south, with key border points like **Karimganj and Dhubri**.
 
• India and Bangladesh share a strong bilateral relationship, with Assam being a critical point for trade and transit.
 
 
 
• **Connectivity via Assam:**
 
 
• Assam is a gateway to northeastern India, connecting the region to the rest of the country through the **Siliguri Corridor** (also known as the Chicken's Neck).
 
• It serves as a hub for trade, transportation, and cultural exchanges between India and its neighbors.

questions.question: In Windows 10 File Explorer, how can you group files by their type?

options.text: Use the 'Sort by' option and select 'Name'
Rename all files with the same type

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Windows 10 File Explorer, the **'Group by'** option allows you to organize files based on specific attributes such as **Type, Name, Date Modified, etc.**.
 
• To group files by their type, navigate to the **'Group by'** menu and select **'Type'**. Files will then be displayed in categories based on their file extensions.
 
• The **'Group by'** feature is accessible via the **right-click context menu** or the **'View' tab** on the ribbon toolbar of File Explorer.
 
• This feature is particularly useful for organizing and quickly locating files of the same type, such as images, documents, or videos.
 
• After grouping by type, you can further refine the organization by applying the **'Sort by'** option to arrange files within each group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **'Group by'** organizes files into categories based on a selected attribute.
 
• **'Sort by'** arranges files in ascending or descending order within a folder.
 
 
 
• **File Type:**
 
 
• File type refers to the specific format or extension of a file (e.g., .jpg, .pdf, .docx).
 
• Grouping files by type helps users manage multiple formats in a single folder efficiently.
 
 
 
• **Accessing File Explorer Options:**
 
 
• To access the 'Group by' option, open File Explorer, navigate to the folder, and right-click on an empty space.
 
• Alternatively, use the **'View' tab** on the ribbon and select **'Group by'**.
 
 
 
• **Customization:**
 
 
• Users can customize the grouping criteria to other attributes like **Date, Size, Name, or Tags**.
 
• This flexibility ensures that File Explorer adapts to specific organizational needs.
 
 
 
• **Windows File Explorer:**
 
 
• File Explorer is the default file management utility in Windows operating systems.

questions.question: The average of three numbers is 23. If two numbers are 11 and 25, the third number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume the **average** (23) as the baseline for all numbers.

Deviation of 11 = 11 − 23 = −12

Deviation of 25 = 25 − 23 = +2

Net deviation of given numbers = −12 + 2 = −10

To maintain the **average**, the third number must balance this by being +10 from the average.

Third number = 23 + 10 = 33

**∴ The correct answer is 33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of **three numbers** = 23

First number = 11

Second number = 25

**Formula:**

Sum of observations = **Average** × **Total number of observations**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10a609c572b018c9f858e7aa7f463c0aa5d93252de823a0863411e7f428a227e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of three numbers = 23 × 3 = 69

⇒ Sum of the two known numbers = 11 + 25 = 36

⇒ Third number = Total Sum − (Sum of two numbers)

⇒ Third number = 69 − 36

⇒ Third number = 33

**&there4$ The correct answer is 33.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Average

The sum of the **deviations** of all observations from their **mean (average)** is always zero. This is a powerful tool for finding missing values in a dataset.

Average of Consecutive Numbers

For a set of **n consecutive numbers** or numbers in an **Arithmetic Progression (AP)**, the average is simply (First Term + Last Term) ÷ 2.

Effect of Change

If every number in a set is increased, decreased, multiplied, or divided by a constant 'k', the **average** of the set also changes by the same constant 'k'.</p

questions.question: Singphos’ Rebellion is associated with which region of present day India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Singphos' Rebellion** is associated with the Singpho tribe, an ethnic group primarily found in the northeastern state of **Assam**.
 
• The rebellion was part of the resistance against British colonial rule in the 19th century, reflecting the tribal community's struggle for autonomy and freedom.
 
• It occurred during the early period of British expansion in Assam, when the Singphos opposed the East India Company's attempts to control their lands.
 
• Singphos are renowned for their warrior traditions and cultural heritage, and they played a significant role in resisting colonial exploitation.
 
• The Singpho community is also credited with introducing tea cultivation in Assam, which later became a global industry under British rule.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Singpho Tribe:**

 
 
• The Singpho tribe belongs to the **Tibeto-Burman linguistic group** and is primarily found in Assam and Arunachal Pradesh in India.
 
• They are closely related to the Kachin people of Myanmar and share cultural and linguistic similarities.
 
 
 
• **Tea Cultivation in Assam:**
 
 
• The Singpho community is believed to have introduced tea plants in Assam, which were later commercialized by the British.
 
• Robert Bruce, a British merchant, reportedly discovered tea plants used by the Singphos in the early 19th century.
 
 
 
• **Resistance Movements in Northeast India:**
 
 
• Tribal resistance against British colonial rule was common in Northeast India, with notable uprisings by the Ahoms, Singphos, and other indigenous groups.
 
• These movements were aimed at protecting land, resources, and cultural autonomy.
 
 
 
• **British Expansion in Assam:**
 
 
• The British East India Company annexed Assam after the Treaty of Yandabo in **1826**, ending Burmese control in the region.
 
• Assam became a key area for tea cultivation and timber extraction under British rule.

questions.question: Which output device is specifically designed to produce high-quality printed graphics and text?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Inkjet Printer**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Inkjet printers** are designed to produce high-quality graphics and text by spraying tiny droplets of liquid ink directly onto paper.
 
• They are widely used for **photo printing** and professional documents due to their superior resolution, typically ranging from **300 to 1200 dpi (dots per inch)** or higher.
 
• Inkjet printers are ideal for **color printing**, making them suitable for posters, brochures, and high-quality images.
 
• These printers support a variety of media, including **photo paper, card stock, and specialty papers**.
 
• They are commonly used in homes and small offices due to their **affordability** and compact size.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dot Matrix Printers**:

 
 
• Dot matrix printers use a matrix of pins to strike an ink ribbon and create images or text on paper.
 
• They are suited for **low-cost, high-volume** printing but produce lower-quality output compared to inkjet printers.
 
 
 
• **Laser Printers**:
 
 
• Laser printers use toner powder and static electricity to produce high-quality text and graphics.
 
• They are faster and more cost-effective for large-scale printing but are generally less effective for high-quality photo printing.
 
 
 
• **Projectors**:
 
 
• Projectors are output devices used to display visuals on a larger screen but are not designed for producing printed graphics or text.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Printers**:
 
 
• Inkjet printers excel in color accuracy and resolution, making them ideal for professionals in graphic design and photography.
 
• While laser printers are more cost-effective for text-heavy documents, they are less versatile in high-quality color printing.

questions.question: Akshay has ₹1,218 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Arjun and Kartik and asked them to invest it at 10% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. It was seen that Arjun and Kartik got the same amount after 12 and 13 years, respectively. How much amount (in ₹) did Akshay give to Kartik?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of shares is determined by the formula: **Higher share : Lower share** = (1 + r/100)Δt : 1

Here, the person with the **shorter duration** (Arjun, 12 years) gets the **higher share**.

Ratio (Arjun : Kartik) = (1 + 10/100)⁽¹³−¹²⁾ : 1 = 1.1 : 1 = **11 : 10**

Total units = 11 + 10 = 21 units → ₹1,218

Kartik share (10 units) = (1218 ÷ 21) × 10 = 58 × 10 = ₹580

**∴ The correct answer is ₹580.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total Principal = ₹1,218 | Rate (r) = 10% | tAᵣjᵤₙ = 12 years | tKₐᵣₜᵢₖ = 13 years.

**Formula Used:** Amount (A) = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a5d6596af4c421a8b19356b4dc0fdfcdf89ad278726e2eeacb7ca8c3a829837.png] 

Let the amount given to **Arjun** be PA and **Kartik** be PK.

⇒ Total Principal = PA + PK = 1218

⇒ Final Amount Arjun = Final Amount Kartik

⇒ PA(1 + 10/100)¹² = PK(1 + 10/100)¹³

⇒ PA × (1.1)¹² = PK × (1.1)¹³

⇒ PA / PK = (1.1)¹³ / (1.1)¹²

⇒ PA / PK = 1.1 = 11 / 10

⇒ Kartik share = [10 / (11 + 10)] × 1218

⇒ Kartik share = (10 / 21) × 1218

⇒ Kartik share = 10 × 58 = ₹580

**∴ The correct answer is ₹580.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Interest Formula

The amount is calculated as A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ, where n is the number of compounding periods.

Effective Interest Rate

For non-annual compounding, the effective rate Rₑff = [1 + r/(100 × m)]m − 1, where m is the frequency of compounding per year.

Rule of 72

A quick shortcut to find the approximate time needed to double an investment: Years to double ≈ 72 ÷ Annual Interest Rate.

questions.question: Which feature of the phosphodiester bond contributes most to the overall negative charge of the DNA molecule?

options.text: The phosphate group’s ionisable oxygen atoms

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The phosphate group's ionisable oxygen atoms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• DNA molecules carry a** negative charge**, primarily due to the presence of the phosphate group in the phosphodiester backbone.
 
• The phosphate group contains **ionisable oxygen atoms** that are negatively charged at physiological pH.
 
• These negatively charged oxygen atoms contribute to the **overall negative charge of the DNA molecule**, which affects its interactions with proteins, cations, and other molecules.
 
• The negative charge of DNA is critical for its **structural stability and biological functions**, such as in its interaction with histones and its electrophoretic mobility during gel-based experiments.
 
• Other components of DNA, such as the nitrogenous bases and the sugar, do not contribute significantly to the molecule's overall charge.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Phosphodiester Bond:**

 
 
• A phosphodiester bond is a chemical bond formed between the 3'-hydroxyl group of one sugar and the phosphate group attached to the 5'-carbon of another sugar in the DNA or RNA backbone.
 
• This bond is crucial for the formation of the DNA and RNA polymer structure.
 
 
 
• **Role of Negative Charge in DNA:**
 
 
• The negative charge on DNA facilitates its interaction with positively charged proteins such as histones, which help in DNA packaging in chromatin.
 
• It also allows the DNA to migrate towards the positive electrode during electrophoresis, a common laboratory technique for DNA analysis.
 
 
 
• **Physiological pH:**
 
 
• The ionisation of the phosphate group occurs at physiological pH (~7.4), ensuring the DNA remains negatively charged under normal biological conditions.
 
 
 
• **Other Components of DNA:**
 
 
• The nitrogenous bases (adenine, thymine, cytosine, guanine) and the deoxyribose sugar are neutral and do not contribute to the overall charge of the DNA molecule.

questions.question: The population of a village was 1,10,000. It increased by 5% in the first year and increased by 25% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Initial Population** = 1,10,000

**First Year** Increase = 5% → Multiplier = 21/20

**Second Year** Increase = 25% → Multiplier = 5/4

**Final Population** = 1,10,000 × (21/20) × (5/4) = 1,10,000 × (105/80) = 1,44,375

**∴ The correct answer is 1,44,375.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Initial Population (P) = 1,10,000

First year growth rate (R₁) = 5%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05bf93d990a9832a6cf39fd40775ea2b6d9ea9cbd0ce2c07ee51cc42943daaa6.png] 

**Formula:** Final Population = P × (1 + R₁/100) × (1 + R₂/100)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,10,000 + (5% of 1,10,000)

⇒ Population after 1st year = 1,10,000 + 5,500 = 1,15,500

⇒ Population after 2nd year = 1,15,500 + (25% of 1,15,500)

⇒ 25% of 1,15,500 = 1,15,500 ÷ 4 = 28,875

⇒ Final Population = 1,15,500 + 28,875 = 1,44,375

**∴ The correct answer is 1,44,375.**

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then by b%, the net effective change is (a + b + ab/100)%.

Population Decrease

If the population decreases, use the formula P × (1 − R/100)ⁿ where R is the rate of decline.

Constant Growth Rate

If the rate R is constant for n years, the population after n years is A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ.</p

• The Charter Act of 1833 was a significant legislation passed by the British Parliament to reorganize the administration in India.
 
• It centralized the administration by vesting legislative power in the Governor-General of India and his council.
 
• The act led to the establishment of the first **Law Commission in India** in 1834 under the chairmanship of Lord Macaulay.
 
• The Law Commission was tasked with codifying Indian laws, which ultimately resulted in the drafting of the Indian Penal Code (1857).
 
• This act also marked the beginning of the end of the East India Company's commercial activities, focusing solely on governance.

• The Charter Act of 1853 marked the last in the series and led to the initiation of the Indian Civil Services examination.
 
 
 
• **Indian Penal Code (IPC):**
 
 
• The IPC, drafted by the first Law Commission, was completed in 1837 but enacted in 1860 after revisions.
 
• It remains the primary criminal code in India, though it has undergone amendments over the years.
 
 
 
• **Lord Macaulay:**

questions.question: Walking at (5)/(7) of his normal speed, Manish is 20 minutes late in reaching. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and office is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When **distance** is constant, **Speed** is inversely proportional to **Time**.

Speed ratio (New : Normal) = 5 : 7 → Time ratio (New : Normal) = 7 : 5.

Difference in time units = 7 − 5 = 2 units.

Given 2 units = 20 minutes → 1 unit = 10 minutes.

Usual time (5 units) = 5 × 10 = 50 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c40c0244fee48e0900104cf60b7a9349ba5fe61def14d046b557c61d0fab58b.png] 

**Given:** New Speed = 5/7 × Normal Speed; Delay = 20 minutes.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Speed × Time

⇒ Let Usual Speed = S and Usual Time = T.

⇒ Distance = S × T

⇒ New Speed = 5/7 S, New Time = T + 20

⇒ S × T = (5/7 S) × (T + 20)

⇒ T = 5/7 × (T + 20)

⇒ 7T = 5T + 100

⇒ 2T = 100

⇒ T = 50 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 50 min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Inverse Proportion Rule

If a person travels at a/b of their usual speed, the new time taken is b/a of the usual time.

General Formula for Late/Early

Usual Time = (Late time × a) ÷ (b − a) where new speed is a/b of usual speed.

Average Speed

For two equal distances covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = 2xy/(x + y).</p

questions.question: The product of two consecutive positive integers is 960. If the smaller of these two integers is represented by x, which of the options below will correspond to the equation for finding the value of x?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the **smaller integer** be x.

The next **consecutive integer** is (x + 1).

The **product** is given as 960.

Shortcut: x × (x + 1) = 960 ⇒ x² + x − 960 = 0.

**∴ The correct answer is x² + x − 960 = 0.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Smaller integer = x

Product of two **consecutive positive integers** = 960

**Formula Used:**

Product = Integer₁ × Integer₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9953351f12420bca35edd8605415cdedb548015066b6ec138b37f9ead5ff87a6.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the two **consecutive positive integers** be x and (x + 1).

⇒ According to the question, their **product** is 960.

⇒ x × (x + 1) = 960

⇒ x² + x = 960

⇒ x² + x − 960 = 0

This is the **quadratic equation** required to find the value of x.

**∴ The correct answer is x² + x − 960 = 0.**

**__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Integers

Integers that follow each other in order with a difference of 1, represented as n, n+1, n+2, etc.

Standard Quadratic Form

A **quadratic equation** is written as ax² + bx + c = 0, where x represents an unknown variable.

Solving for x

To find x, factorize the equation: x² + 31x − 30x − 960 = 0 ⇒ (x + 32)(x − 30) = 0. Since x is positive, x = 30.</p

questions.question: A can finish a work in 2 days and B can do the same work in 52 days. B worked alone for 26 days and left the job. In how many days can A alone finish the remaining work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work (LCM of 2, 52) = **52 units**.

Efficiency of **B** = 52 ÷ 52 = **1 unit/day**.

Work done by **B** in 26 days = 26 × 1 = **26 units**.

Remaining work = 52 − 26 = **26 units**.

Efficiency of **A** = 52 ÷ 2 = **26 units/day**.

Time for **A** to finish = 26 ÷ 26 = **1 day**.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Time taken by **A** = 2 days, Time taken by **B** = 52 days.

 
 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency** 
 **A** 2 52 26 
 **B** 52 1 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done by **B** in 26 days = Efficiency × Time

⇒ Work done by **B** = 1 × 26 = **26 units**

⇒ Remaining Work = Total Work − Work Done

⇒ Remaining Work = 52 − 26 = **26 units**

⇒ Time taken by **A** alone = Remaining Work ÷ Efficiency of A

⇒ Time taken by **A** = 26 ÷ 26 = **1 day**

**∴ The correct answer is 1 day.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Given SP₁ = 950 ⇒ 95% of CP = 950 ⇒ 1% of CP = 10.

The new Selling Price (SP₂) = 1360.

As 10 corresponds to 1%, 1360 corresponds to (1360 ÷ 10) = 136%.

New Profit % (x) = 136% − 100% = 36%.

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

**Total Amount** percentage = 100% (Principal) + 20% (Interest) = 120%

**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹720 | Rate (R) = 4% per annum | Time (T) = 5 years

⇒ P = (720 × 5) ÷ 6

⇒ P = 120 × 5

⇒ P = 600

**∴ The correct answer is ₹600.**

Simple Interest Formula

Simple interest is calculated only on the initial principal. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

questions.question: What is the central theme of the first five anthologies (Kuruntokai, Narrinai, Akananuru, Ainkurunuru, and Kalittokai) of the Ettuttokai in the Sangam literature?

The correct answer is __**Akam**__.

__
 
• The first five anthologies of the Ettuttokai in Sangam literature are part of the **Akam** category, which deals with themes of love and personal emotions.
 
• Akam poetry focuses on the inner, emotional, and personal aspects of human life, specifically romantic relationships, without direct reference to external societal events.
 
• Each anthology in this category portrays different aspects of love, such as longing, separation, union, and misunderstandings.
 
• The poems use symbolic landscapes, known as "tinai," to represent emotional states and situations, such as mountains for union and deserts for separation.
 
• The Akam theme is central to Tamil Sangam literature, emphasizing the intimate and universal emotions of love and relationships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Sangam literature is one of the oldest known Tamil literary traditions, dating back to 300 BCE–300 CE.
 
• It is broadly divided into two themes: **Akam** (inner life, love) and **Puram** (outer life, valor, and society).
 
 
 
• **Ettuttokai:**
 
 
• It is a collection of eight anthologies of Sangam poetry, divided into Akam (love) and Puram (valor).
 
• The first five anthologies (Kuruntokai, Narrinai, Akananuru, Ainkurunuru, and Kalittokai) fall under the Akam category.
 
 
 
• **Tinai Concept:**
 
 
• In Akam poetry, tinai refers to symbolic landscapes used to depict specific emotions and situations in love.
 
• Examples include **kurinji** (mountains for union) and **palai** (deserts for separation).
 
 
 
• **Puram Literature:**
 
 
• Puram focuses on themes of heroism, ethics, and public life, contrasting with the personal nature of Akam poetry.
 
 
 
• **Importance:**

questions.question: Which seasonal change marks the withdrawal of monsoon in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Southward shift of ITCZ**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The withdrawal of monsoon in India is marked by the **southward shift of the Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ).**
 
• The ITCZ is a belt of low pressure near the equator where the trade winds converge and plays a crucial role in the monsoon system.
 
• During the withdrawal phase, the ITCZ shifts southward towards the equator, signaling the end of the rainy season.
 
• Withdrawal typically starts in northwest India by early October and progresses southward across the country.
 
• This shift is accompanied by clear skies, a reduction in humidity, and a rise in daytime temperatures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ):**

 
 
• The ITCZ is a dynamic region of low pressure near the equator formed by the convergence of northeast and southeast trade winds.
 
• It shifts northward and southward seasonally due to the apparent movement of the sun.
 
• Its position influences the monsoon rains in tropical regions, including India.
 
 
 
• **Indian Monsoon System:**
 
 
• The Indian monsoon is divided into two phases: **onset** (arrival) and **withdrawal** (retreat).
 
• The monsoon onset is driven by the northward movement of the ITCZ, while its withdrawal is linked to the southward shift.
 
 
 
• **Withdrawal of Monsoon:**
 
 
• The withdrawal process begins in northwest India and progresses southward, completing by November.
 
• It is marked by clear skies, reduced rainfall, and a gradual cooling of temperatures.
 
 
 
• **Polar Jet Streams:**
 
 
• These high-altitude winds influence weather patterns but are not directly linked to the withdrawal of the Indian monsoon.

questions.question: Two positive numbers differ by 2858. When the greater number is divided by the smaller number, the quotient is 5 and the remainder is 178. What is the HCF of the greater of the two given numbers and 3828?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the smaller number be **x**. Then greater number = **5x + 178**.

Difference: **(5x + 178) − x = 2858**

⇒ **4x = 2680** → **x = 670**.

Greater number = **670 + 2858 = 3528**.

HCF of **3528** and **3828**: Difference is **300**. HCF must be a factor of 300. Check options: 12 divides both.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e622b9692819748b33a4489a4a33b6702d55fc6b9b18d7b998c35465e15a0c70.png] 

**Given:** Difference **D = 2858**, Quotient **Q = 5**, Remainder **R = 178**.

**Formula Used:** Dividend = (Divisor × Quotient) + Remainder

⇒ Let numbers be **G** (greater) and **S** (smaller).

⇒ **G − S = 2858** ... (i)

⇒ **G = 5S + 178** ... (ii)

⇒ Substitute (ii) in (i): **(5S + 178) − S = 2858**

⇒ **4S = 2858 − 178 = 2680**

⇒ **S = 670**

⇒ **G = 670 + 2858 = 3528**

⇒ Now find **HCF(3528, 3828)**:

⇒ **3828 − 3528 = 300**

⇒ Factors of 300: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10, **12**, 15...

⇒ 3528 ÷ 12 = 294; 3828 ÷ 12 = 319.

**∴ The correct answer is 12.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Division Algorithm

For any integer **a** and positive integer **b**, there exist unique integers **q** and **r** such that **a = bq + r**, where 0 ≤ **r** < **b**.

HCF Property

The **HCF** of two numbers also divides their **difference**. This is a very useful trick for finding the HCF of large numbers quickly.

Euclidean Algorithm

A process of repeated division to find **HCF** where **HCF(a, b) = HCF(b, r)** until the remainder becomes zero.</p

questions.question: Pipes A and B can fill an empty cistern in 84 minutes and 36 minutes, respectively. Both Pipe A and Pipe B are opened together. After how much time should Pipe B be turned off so that the empty cistern is completely filled in a total of 42 minutes?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
**Total Work** (LCM of 84 and 36) = 252 units.

Efficiency of **Pipe A** = 252 ÷ 84 = 3 units/min.

Efficiency of **Pipe B** = 252 ÷ 36 = 7 units/min.

**Pipe A** works for the full 42 minutes: 3 × 42 = 126 units.

Remaining work for **Pipe B** = 252 − 126 = 126 units.

Time for **Pipe B** = 126 ÷ 7 = 18 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 18 min.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 **Person** **Days** **Total Work** **Efficiency**
 **Pipe A** 84 min 252 3
 **Pipe B** 36 min 7
**Given:**

Time taken by **Pipe A** = 84 min

Time taken by **Pipe B** = 36 min

Total time for cistern to fill = 42 min

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let **Pipe B** be closed after **x** minutes.

⇒ **Pipe A** works for the entire 42 minutes.

⇒ Work done by **Pipe A** in 42 minutes = 3 × 42 = 126 units

⇒ Remaining work to be filled by **Pipe B** = 252 − 126 = 126 units

⇒ Time for which **Pipe B** was open (x) = 126 ÷ 7

⇒ x = 18 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 18 min.**

**__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Efficiency

Efficiency is inversely proportional to the time taken. If a pipe fills a tank in T minutes, its efficiency is 1/T per minute.

Negative Work (Outlet Pipe)

If an outlet pipe (leak) is present, its efficiency is taken as negative during the total work calculation.

Total Work Calculation

Total Work = Time × Combined Efficiency. Always use the LCM of individual times to assume a convenient value for total capacity.</p

__
 
• Lok Adalat decisions are **final and binding** on both parties, ensuring disputes do not escalate further.
 
• There is **no provision for an appeal** against the decision made in a Lok Adalat to maintain efficiency and avoid prolonged litigation.
 
• Lok Adalats are known for **speedy resolution** of disputes, avoiding lengthy court procedures.
 
• They provide **cost-effective justice** by eliminating court fees and reducing financial burden on litigants.
 
• Lok Adalats aim to resolve disputes through **mutual consent and compromise**, promoting harmony between parties.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Lok Adalat, meaning "People's Court," is a statutory mechanism under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.
 
• It resolves disputes through **conciliation and compromise**, without a formal judicial trial.
 
• It is aimed at reducing the burden on regular courts and providing quick justice.
 
 
 
• **Legal Basis:**
 
 
• The Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 empowers Lok Adalats to resolve civil, matrimonial, and compoundable criminal cases.
 
• Its primary focus is on disputes where parties are willing to resolve issues amicably.
 
 
 
• **Advantages of Lok Adalat:**
 
 
• Lok Adalats help reduce the backlog of cases in courts.
 
• They provide free and speedy justice, ensuring accessibility for economically weaker sections.
 
• There is no strict adherence to procedural laws, making the process informal and efficient.
 
 
 
• **Limitations:**
 
 
• Decisions are binding and final, meaning no further appeal can be made.
 
• Lok Adalats can only handle cases where both parties agree to a settlement; contested cases are referred back to regular courts.

questions.question: The average of Anwar's marks in seven subjects is 75. His average in six subjects excluding Science is 70. How many marks did he get in Science?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Science** marks = Original **Average** + (Difference in Average × Number of remaining subjects)

Difference in **Average** = 75 − 70 = 5

Marks in **Science** = 75 + (5 × 6)

Marks in **Science** = 75 + 30 = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average marks of **Anwar** in **7 subjects** = 75

Average marks in **6 subjects** (excluding **Science**) = 70

**Formula Used:**

Sum of observations = **Average** × **Number of observations**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a685b42c5dfafd9575b4379dffae698fcdc1e4982b00e41fcc16b102ba3a3069.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total marks in **7 subjects** = 75 × 7 = 525

⇒ Total marks in **6 subjects** = 70 × 6 = 420

⇒ Marks in **Science** = (Total marks in 7 subjects) − (Total marks in 6 subjects)

⇒ Marks in **Science** = 525 − 420 = 105

**∴ The correct answer is 105 marks.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average of Group

The **Arithmetic Mean** or **Average** is calculated by dividing the sum of all values by the total number of values: Average = Σx ÷ n.

Effect of Exclusion

When a value is excluded, if the **Average** decreases, the excluded value must be greater than the original average. Excluded Value = (Old Average × Old Count) − (New Average × New Count).

Weighted Average

When two groups are combined, the **Combined Average** = (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p

questions.question:
A hollow spherical shell is made of a metal of density 21 g/cm³. Its internal and external radii are 8 cm and 9 cm, respectively. What is the weight (in kg) of the shell?

( {Use} pi = (22)/(7), {Density} = frac{{Mass}}{{Volume}} )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of metal = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³)

Mass = Volume × Density = 4/3 × 22/7 × (9³ − 8³) × 21

Mass = 4/3 × 22/7 × (729 − 512) × 21 = 88 × 217 = 19096 g

Weight in kg = 19096 ÷ 1000 = 19.096 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 19.096 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** External radius (R) = 9 cm, Internal radius (r) = 8 cm, Density = 21 g/cm³

**Formula Used:** Volume of hollow sphere = 4/3 × π × (R³ − r³); Mass = Density × Volume

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9908f41a30cfeab5ded5bf931cc25250f8ed6fa998530122b2aae4754c6afc28.png] 

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (9³ − 8³)

⇒ Volume = 4/3 × 22/7 × (729 − 512) = 4/3 × 22/7 × 217

⇒ Volume = 88/21 × 217 cm³

⇒ Mass = Density × Volume = 21 × (88/21 × 217)

⇒ Mass = 88 × 217 = 19096 g

⇒ Weight in kg = 19096 / 1000 = 19.096 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 19.096 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Hollow Sphere Properties

The volume of the material is the difference between external and internal volumes: V = 4/3π(R³−r³).

Density-Mass Relation

Mass is the product of Volume and Density. Unit conversion: 1 kg = 1000 g.

Total Surface Area of Hollow Sphere

The sum of inner and outer surface areas: TSA = 4πR² + 4πr² = 4π(R²+r²).</p
